Receipt Processor stores receipt and item data in SQLite and provides functions
for summarizing spending. This tutorial installs the published package, creates
a small example database, and runs a few queries.

## Install

Receipt Processor supports Python 3.11. Install the published package from
[PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/receipt-processor/):

```bash
python -m pip install receipt-processor
```

To work from the source repository instead, clone it and install its declared
dependencies:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Xapamma/Receipt-Processor.git
cd Receipt-Processor
python -m pip install .
```

## Add and analyze a receipt

The example creates temporary databases so it can be run repeatedly without
changing your own receipt data. Each receipt has a `store_name`, `date`, `time`,
`total_amount`, and a `transactions` list.

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory

from receipt_processor.db_ingest import initialize_database, insert_receipt
from receipt_processor.db_queries import (
    get_category_breakdown,
    get_total_spending,
)

with TemporaryDirectory() as temp_dir:
    database_path = Path(temp_dir) / "receipts.db"
    initialize_database(db_path=database_path)
    receipt_id = insert_receipt(
        {
            "store_name": "Example Market",
            "date": "2026-10-08",
            "time": "12:00",
            "total_amount": 12.00,
            "transactions": [
                {"item_name": "Apples", "price": 5.00, "category": "food"},
                {"item_name": "Soap", "price": 7.00, "category": "personal_care"},
            ],
        },
        db_path=database_path,
    )

    total = get_total_spending(db_path=database_path)
    categories = get_category_breakdown(db_path=database_path)

    print(f"Inserted receipt #{receipt_id}")
    print(f"Total spending: ${total:.2f}")
    print(categories)
```

`get_total_spending` returns the combined receipt total. The category query
groups item totals and includes allocated tax.

## Track a monthly budget

Budget functions require a month key in `YYYY-MM` format. They create the
budget database tables if needed.

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory

from receipt_processor.db_queries import (
    get_category_budgets,
    get_monthly_budget,
    save_category_budget,
    save_monthly_budget,
)
from receipt_processor.db_ingest import initialize_budget_database

with TemporaryDirectory() as temp_dir:
    budget_database_path = Path(temp_dir) / "budget.db"
    initialize_budget_database(db_path=budget_database_path)
    month_key = "2026-10"

    save_monthly_budget(
        month_key=month_key,
        total_budget=300.00,
        db_path=budget_database_path,
    )
    save_category_budget(
        month_key=month_key,
        category="food",
        budget=150.00,
        db_path=budget_database_path,
    )

    print(get_monthly_budget(month_key, db_path=budget_database_path))
    print(get_category_budgets(month_key, db_path=budget_database_path))
```

## Run the app and find references

For a local source checkout, run:

```bash
streamlit run app.py
```

The hosted [Streamlit app](https://receipt-pro-stat386.streamlit.app/) can also
be opened in a browser. Find the complete function reference in the
[API documentation](api.qmd), the project analysis in the
[technical report](technical-report.qmd), and the source code on
[GitHub](https://github.com/Xapamma/Receipt-Processor).
